texts.zh:
这位科学家全神贯注地看着手中的输入板，手指对着按键上下纷飞。她哼着欢快的旋律，似乎对工作心无旁骛。一个小型机器人同伴漂浮在她旁边的空中，它发出叽叽喳喳的声音，磕了一下她的肩膀。她倏然抬起头。

啊，对不起。你好！我是佐西拉。很抱歉打扰你们，那个，我之前的实验室相当于是，爆炸了。

小机器人又叽叽喳喳了起来。

啊所以，那个，我是说，我想要找一个地方能让我继续作曲。
texts.en:
The scientist is focused on a tablet in her hand. As her fingers dance over the keys, she hums a cheerful melody. She seems lost in her work and oblivious to the world. A small robot companion floats in the air next to her; it chirps and bumps her shoulder. She looks up.

Oh, sorry. Hello, I'm Zosira. Sorry to bother you, but my last lab, well, it sort of blew up.

The small robot chirps again.

Ah, yes, what I am trying to say is that I'm looking for a place to compose.

responses.zh:
是啊，宇宙就像音乐一样。环绕着的气态巨行星的振动，新生恒星的咆哮，盘旋原子的甜美歌谣……

她像是在指挥一支看不见的宇宙交响乐队一样挥舞着双手。

哒~哒~啦~噔~，加上合适的节奏，然后：当当！于是我们就创造了魔法！啊不是，科学。差不多一回事，真的。
responses.en:
The universe is music. The vibrations from the orbiting gas giants, the roar of a newborn star, the sweet song of swirling atoms...

She gestures with her hands as if she were conducting an invisible cosmic orchestra.

Da da da dum, then add a fitting rhythm and: tadaa! We have created magic! Or, well, science. The same thing, really.

label.en: Why do you seek to join us?

responses.zh:
你们的想法看起来相当合意。我希望自己的发现能造福每个人，而不只是权贵子弟。这支宇宙的交响乐里可包含了奇迹和魔法！每个人都应该听到！

小机器人继续叽叽喳喳。

就是这样戈尔基！你说得一点儿也没错。
responses.en:
Your head seems to be in the right place. I want my discoveries to benefit everyone, not just the rich and powerful. The symphony of the universe, the wonders, the magic! Everyone deserves to hear it!

The small robot chirps.

That's right Gorky! Very well said.

responses.zh:
欧，这是戈尔基！他是不是超可爱的？他是我自己造的，我做什么他都帮得上忙。

小机器人开心地叽叽喳喳。

好呀，好呀，我会告诉他们的。戈尔基为我安排会见、吃饭、饮水和睡眠的时间。你知道，我要是为一件事着迷的时候，就……咻——地会忘记时间。

小机器人继续叽叽喳喳。

哈哈对！就是就是！
responses.en:
Oh, this is Gorky! Isn't he adorable? I built him myself, and he helps me with everything.

The robot chirps happily.

Okay, okay, I'll tell them. Gorky makes sure that I make my meetings, eat, drink and sleep. You know, when I get passionate about something, it's just... swoosh! I lose all track of time.

Gorky chirps again.

Ha ha, yes! Exactly!

label.en: You say your lab blew up?

responses.zh:
哦，哎呀，怎么说呢？！你瞧，我的家乡在关于谁能当科学家这件事可是相当苛刻。所以，我从老旧工业区里搜刮破烂，悄悄组建了自己的实验室。我本以为离子化力场可以让易爆微粒稳定下来，但是……

小机器人一边叽叽喳喳一边发出滴滴声。

对吧？那些微粒的重低音可真是太劲爆了。所以我什么时候可以开始？
responses.en:
Oh, wow, where to start?! You see, my homeworld is very restrictive when it comes to who is allowed to be a scientist. So, I put together the lab in secret using whatever I could scavenge from the old industrial zones. Now, I thought the ionization field would keep the volatile motes stable, but...

The small robot chirps and beeps.

Right? The bass from those motes was truly booming. So when do I start?

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]和[Root.GetHisHer]的机器人伙伴戈尔基花费大部分业余时间进行私人实验。其中一些现在得到了有趣的结果，[Root.GetHeShe]与我们帝国的科学家们分享了[Root.GetHisHer]的发现。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] and [Root.GetHisHer] robot companion Gorky have spent much of their spare time conducting private experiments. Some of them have now yielded interesting results, and [Root.GetHeShe] has shared [Root.GetHisHer] findings with our empire's scientists.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]收养了一只外星生物来陪伴[Root.GetHisHer]的机器人助手戈尔基。它是一只五彩斑斓的未开智软体动物，表现出了不俗的智力，能对口哨指令作出反应。收养这只生物似乎改变了[Root.GetHisHer]的性格，[Root.GetHimHer]变得更加有责任心，更加安定了。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] has adopted an alien creature to accompany [Root.GetHisHer] robot assistant Gorky. It's a colorful mollusk who, though pre-sapient, exhibits an impressive intellect and responds to whistled commands. Taking responsibility for the creature appears to have altered [Root.GetHisHer] personality, making [Root.GetHimHer] far more responsible and balanced.

summary.text:
# 佐西拉·科顿 / Zosira K'Tun

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/paragon_events_4.txt:864-960、2785-2857, 2861-2888、1728–1866（paragon.41234）、15–160（paragon.40000/40001）· DLC：典范 Galactic Paragons · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-12

## 如何开始 How it starts

“知名领袖”抽签：每十年（on_decade_pulse_country）隐藏事件 paragon.40000 检查（典范DLC、玩家、非杀戮帝国、已研究外星语言学、近期未招募），按基础1（有招募办公室+2）对“随失败而递增”的权重决定是否在1–360天内抽签（40001）。抽签只放入与本国思潮相符、尚未出现过且未被解雇的领袖；本故事的人物属于**平等**思潮（renowned_egalitarian2）。
Renowned leader lottery: each decade hidden paragon.40000 (Paragon, player, not homicidal, Xeno-Linguistics, no recent recruit) may draw within 1–360 days (40001); only leaders matching your ethics, not yet offered and not dismissed are in the pool. This one is **egalitarian**.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. 招募对话：带着小机器人戈尔基、实验室刚炸毁的科学家。可反复询问（只显示回答），然后“解雇”或“招募”。
   Recruitment: a scientist with her little robot Gorky, whose lab just blew up. Ask questions (replies only), then dismiss or enlist.
2. 招募后，每十年隐藏事件 paragon.41234 随机挑选一名知名领袖，对此人按10%/10%/80%抽取下面两段故事之一或都不发生，延迟1–1800天；两段都只发生一次，可在不同的十年里先后出现。
   After hiring, every decade paragon.41234 picks a renowned leader; for this one 10% / 10% / 80% (nothing), 1–1800 days later. Each episode fires once; both may happen in different decades.

- **科学就是魔法 / Science is Magic**（paragon.40810）：私人实验成果：随机获得物理研究（10%可能改为开启科学枢纽科技）。
  private experiments pay off: random physics research (10% chance of the Science Nexus tech option).
- **收养外星宠物 / Adopted Alien Pet**（paragon.40820）：收养外星宠物：移除负面特质，获得“情绪支持宠物”（条件：尚无“情绪支持宠物”特质）。
  she adopts an alien pet: negative traits removed, gains the emotional support pet trait.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- “解雇”：人物回到全局池，但本国设置 dismissed 标记，以后不会再抽到。“招募”：成为知名领袖（李萨拓等人另带舰队）。
  Dismiss: never offered to you again. Enlist: becomes a renowned leader.
- 两段后续是相互独立的随机事件，不是先后两章；领袖死亡或离开后不再发生。
  The two episodes are independent random events, not chapters in order.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 只有拥有平等思潮的帝国会被提供此人。后续故事的额外条件见上（括号内）。
  Offered only to egalitarian empires; extra episode conditions are given in brackets above.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：40000/40001 抽签与权重（01_script_values_paragon.txt ethic_leader_randomizer）、招募事件全部选项、ethic_leader_hire_effect 设置领袖标记、41234 的分派与权重、后续事件的触发条件、选项与项目。
- 更正 Corrections：原先十六名领袖的招募对话被合成一个故事（按抽签器），而所有后续故事又被合成另一个故事；现按人物拆分，每人一则故事，招募后接各自的后续。
  The lottery-based story and the follow-up story were split into one story per leader.
- 不确定 Uncertain：每十年只随机挑选一名知名领袖进行判定，拥有多名知名领袖时后续可能更晚出现。
